targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-876 (2026-08-02) is the first fair V3 test of MECH-025 -- all three prior instrument defects (050/050b/199: cache-field/torn-down-field commitment read, frozen running_variance during eval) are fixed and verified (committed/uncommitted regimes both well-sampled every seed, non-degenerate). doing_mode_delta is consistently negative (4/5 seeds), opposite the predicted sign. This is read as non_contributory / measurement_test_design_defect, not claim pressure: the claim's own cited literature (Friston 2013's recorded failure_signature: precision is continuous, not a discrete mode switch; Thura & Cisek 2014: PMd/M1 representations converge, not diverge, during commitment) predicts the operationalization's sign convention may be backwards. Precision itself separates by 4-5 orders of magnitude in every seed (unambiguous, but a near-tautological consequence of ARC-016's commit rule, and not currently scored as a criterion). Route: /queue-experiment redesign, testing either the reversed sign or precision itself as the primary DV.
learning_extracted: MECH-025 now has its first-ever fair V3 test: precision/commitment separation is unambiguous (4-5 orders of magnitude) in every seed, confirming ARC-016's mechanism reaches this substrate cleanly.

The specific downstream operationalization (harm-counterfactual differentiation, predicted larger when committed) is contradicted by the claim's own cited literature (Thura & Cisek 2014 predicts convergence/narrowing during commitment, not divergence) -- a biology-divergence finding discovered by re-reading the claim's existing lit entries, not new literature.

Precision itself (the claim's literal subject, 'high-precision control') was recorded but never scored as a criterion -- a direct precision-based DV is available for a redesign without new instrumentation.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-671b (2026-08-03) is the first fair, fully-gated test of MECH-025b. Both positive-control gates (residue accumulation, precision variance) clear cleanly; the correlation the claim predicts (precision_residue_correlation > 0.15) reads -0.0446, and the ratio test (> 1.1) reads 1.0618 -- both null, consistently across the 3 seeds with real committed-step spread. Unlike MECH-025 (same cluster, V3-EXQ-876), this test does not depend on MECH-025's own operationalization succeeding -- it correlates E3's own precision value directly against residue accumulation, both independently confirmed live this run. Read as weakens / standard -- real claim pressure against the precision-implies-accountability bridge specifically. No biological reference exists to check this against (the claim is explicitly a philosophical construct, not a translated neuroscience finding). No demotion recommended this cycle -- single result, and pooled n is modest (179, unevenly distributed across seeds: 29/72/77/1).
learning_extracted: First fair, fully-gated test of MECH-025b: both positive-control gates (residue accumulation, precision variance) clear, and the correlation/ratio the claim predicts both read null.

This test is self-contained -- it does not require MECH-025's own causal-signature claim to hold, since it correlates E3 precision directly against residue accumulation, both confirmed live in this run.

cluster_pattern.shape: Both siblings share a fully instrument-clean measurement of E3 precision/commitment (ARC-016) in this cycle, and in both cases precision/commitment separation is unambiguous while the downstream functional consequence each claim predicts from it fails to appear, for different specific reasons.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: Precision separation is real and large (ARC-016 confirmed operative in both scripts), but neither of the two hypothesized higher-level functional readouts built on top of it -- harm-differentiation signature (MECH-025) or responsibility-residue weighting (MECH-025b) -- has yet been shown to track it. This is not evidence the precision mechanism itself is wrong; it is evidence the two claims layered on top of it need independent re-examination: MECH-025's DV/sign (operationalization mismatch, re-queue), and MECH-025b's bridge-claim status (genuine null, note).
